RPC stops deadline-1000; TERM until min(deadline-500,now+300); KILL to same deadline; poll <=20ms. Cleanup-indeterminate persists.
Connection/statement/transaction defaults; public overrides 1..300000ms not used here; late client released; adapter dispose only seals.
